select ba.id, ba.title, ba.summary, ba.content, ba.cover_url, ba.category_id, ba.author_id, ba.author_name, ba.is_top, ba.is_recommend, ba.status, ba.view_count, ba.like_count, ba.comment_count, ba.create_time, ba.update_time, ba.del_flag from zhi_article ba where ba.title = #{title} and ba.del_flag = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update zhi_article set view_count = IFNULL(view_count, 0) + 1 where id = #{id}
update zhi_article set view_count = IFNULL(view_count, 0) + #{increment} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select ba.id, ba.title, ba.summary, ba.cover_url, ba.category_id, ba.author_id, ba.author_name, ba.is_top, ba.is_recommend, ba.status, ba.view_count, ba.like_count, ba.comment_count, ba.create_time, ba.update_time, ba.del_flag, bc.name as category_name from zhi_article ba left join zhi_category bc on ba.category_id = bc.id and bc.del_flag = 0 inner join zhi_article_tag bat on ba.id = bat.article_id where bat.tag_id = #{tagId} and ba.status = 1 and ba.del_flag = 0 order by ba.create_time desc, ba.id desc

mapper.select: SELECT ba.id, ba.title, ba.summary, ba.cover_url, ba.category_id, ba.author_id, ba.author_name, ba.is_top, ba.is_recommend, ba.status, ba.view_count, ba.like_count, ba.comment_count, ba.create_time, ba.update_time, ba.del_flag, bc.name as category_name FROM zhi_article ba LEFT JOIN zhi_category bc ON ba.category_id = bc.id AND bc.del_flag = 0 WHERE ba.status = 1 AND ba.del_flag = 0 AND ba.id != #{id} AND ba.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM zhi_article WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0) ORDER BY ba.view_count DESC, ba.create_time DESC, ba.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE zhi_article SET status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 2 AND publish_time IS NOT NULL AND publish_time <= NOW() AND del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT 'article' AS reference_type, id AS reference_id, title AS reference_title FROM zhi_article WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cover_url LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR gallery LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR selling_points LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR spec_table LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
